resources.string: Debug build: install new builds with adb.
You have the newest version of Bridgit.
Closes by itself. Tap to close now.
You have Bridgit %1$s, which is newer than the published %2$s.
Update offers off. Check for updates is in More.
Once a day, when you open Bridgit, it checks for a newer version and offers it
After the download, Bridgit checks it, then you tap Install.
Bridgit %1$s is downloaded and checked. Android will ask you to confirm the install. Your control agents, keys, switches and log are not modified by this upgrade.
Bridgit %1$s is downloaded and checked. Tap Install: Bridgit closes and updates, then a notice lets you open it again. Your control agents, keys, switches and log are not modified by this upgrade.

Bridgit %1$s is downloaded and checked. Bridgit installs it over its own ADB link, with no confirm, and opens again by itself. Your control agents, keys, switches and log are not modified by this upgrade.
Installing Bridgit %1$s. Bridgit closes; tap the notice to open it again.
Installing Bridgit %1$s. Bridgit closes and opens again by itself.
To install its own updates, Bridgit needs Android\'s \"Install unknown apps\" permission. On the next page, turn on \"Allow from this source\", then come back and tap Install.
Android\'s installer didn\'t open. Try again, or install the file with adb.
Bridgit couldn\'t reach the update server. Check your connection and try again.
The update server didn\'t answer properly. Try again later.
The update server refused the request.
The update server tried to send Bridgit somewhere else, so Bridgit stopped. Nothing was installed.
The published update information isn\'t valid, so Bridgit ignored it.
The download doesn\'t match the published update, so Bridgit deleted it.
The download isn\'t a valid app file, so Bridgit deleted it.
The download isn\'t the version that was published, so Bridgit deleted it.
The download isn\'t newer than the Bridgit you have, so Bridgit deleted it.
The download isn\'t signed with Bridgit\'s key, so Bridgit deleted it.
Bridgit couldn\'t save the download. Free some space and try again.
Lets Bridgit install its own updates after you confirm.
